body:
On a bright thursday afternoon my friend sue and I decided to smoke marijauna. It was her first time so I was quite excited. We called up my friend and went over to his house to pick up a bit of green. We smoked out of a bong. My friend was acting crazy, and he explained his actions where because of this unusual nerve pill calld klonipin. 3 bucks is a good deal for anything so I bought it. I took it. About an hour later the most pleasant feelin hit me. I was kind of floating and extremly content with life. After about an hour and a half it began to go away. But even that was pleasent. It felt like just waking up on a sunny morning. Stretching was great and I just felt good.
Yeah. It was fun. Dont see how anything negative could have came out of it
